title: Catalogue item
description: A single capability requirement inside a tool. THE UNIT PROGRESS ATTACHES TO. Progress attaches to a versioned capability block, never to a quest, chapter or route — two contexts reusing a block share credit because they read one record.

id.description: Stable identifier. Never a title — titles change.

toolId.description: The tool this item belongs to.

version.description: Inherited from the tool. An item is not independently versioned.

purpose.description: Plain-language statement of what this item is for.

authorityClass.description: Where the content's authority comes from, and therefore what may be claimed about it. A = controlling or official. B = programme material requiring owner confirmation. C = derived implementation content, not automatically normative. D = product hypothesis or prototype.

classification.description: What the item is FOR. `unclassified` is a real member, not an absence — and an unclassified item CANNOT BE EXECUTED. Defaulting a classification is not a fix; it is a judgement about what the tool is for, and guessing produces a tool that executes incorrectly rather than one that refuses honestly.

specialistReviewRequired.description: High-risk technical, clinical, structural, fire or hazardous-material content. When true the item is readable and clearly labelled but CANNOT BE EXECUTED until a qualified reviewer signs.

specialistReviewSignedBy.description: Null while review is outstanding. Execution is refused with `specialist-review-required-before-execution`.

lifecycleState.description: Consumers read APPROVED versions only. A published version is never edited — a change creates a new version and preserves the prior one.

provenance.description: Minimum metadata. An item without complete provenance is refused with `insufficient-provenance`.

applicability.description: Orthogonal filter axes — deliberately NOT a hierarchy. The same item legitimately belongs to several, and forcing one primary classification loses that.

evidenceRule.description: What counts as done. Required — an item whose completion cannot be described cannot be evidenced.

capabilityBlockRef.description: The reusable versioned block this item reads. TWO CONTEXTS REFERENCING ONE BLOCK SHARE CREDIT. Skipping this produces parallel checklists that each earn separately, so a facility doing one piece of work is credited once, twice, or not at all depending which checklist they opened.

reviewDate.description: Content ages. Expiry is surfaced, never silently enforced — an expired item stays readable and is labelled.

localeCoverage.description: Locales this item is translated into. Coverage is computed and reported, never discovered by a user.

localisedText.description: No user-visible string is ever a literal. Every one is a locale key.

fallback.description: Development label only. Its presence in a published bundle is reported by the manifest as a provisional string awaiting native-language review.

sourceLocation.description: Page or section. Provenance is PER ITEM, not per document.

reproductionPermission.description: HAVING A FILE DOES NOT IMPLY PERMISSION TO PUBLISH IT. Publication requires `confirmed` or `not-required`; `pending` may be ingested as draft but never published.
